subject: stormursa
authorization: Standing owner direction 1 (Meshy, no generation cap); RD-28; F29#3; CLAUDE.md art rule (agent-drafted reference)

meshy_model_task.input_images_note: views from the concept task listed (front first)

concept_tasks.prompt: The SAME bear as the first two images, keeping its warm chestnut-brown fur and glowing violet lightning veins (third image is identity only: this is the adult evolution of that Staticub cub). Adult storm bear: heavier body, higher shoulders with a pronounced shoulder hump; a thick storm-fur ruff around the neck and shoulders made of the same chestnut-brown fur, darker-tipped with slate violet, grown naturally from the body (not an accessory, not armour, not a separate mane piece, no crystals or plates); a darker brown fur ridge running along the spine; bright blue eyes with a white catchlight; bigger head and bigger paws with pale claws. Matte painted stylised fur in clean colour blocks, like a Palworld-class creature game: not photoreal, not glossy vinyl. Absolutely no red, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Neutral four-legged standing pose, all four legs straight and clearly separated from the body and from each other with visible gaps between them, full body visible, plain neutral background.
concept_tasks.verdict: rejected: stray white mark on forehead; ruff read as a separate slate collar

concept_tasks.prompt: The SAME bear as the first two images, keeping its warm chestnut-brown fur and glowing violet lightning veins (third image is identity only: this is the adult evolution of that Staticub cub). Matte painted stylised fur in clean colour blocks, like a Palworld-class creature game: not photoreal, not glossy vinyl. Absolutely no red, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Neutral four-legged standing pose, all four legs straight and clearly separated from the body and from each other with visible gaps between them, full body visible, plain neutral background.
concept_tasks.verdict: chosen: identity kept, clean forehead, hump, slate-tipped ruff, spine ridge, legs separated

candidates.generation_verdict: Candidate A (recommended for the stronger ruff read). Identity kept (chestnut fur, violet veins, blue eyes), shoulder hump, slate-violet-tipped ruff, darker spine ridge; legs separated in front/back/side previews; no red accents. Fur is a warm chestnut similar to native-standing-v1. Mesh bbox 0.82 x 1.27 x 1.89 (W x H x L, Meshy units); scale uniformly so standing height = 4.10 m at integration (length then ~6.1 m). Unrigged.

alignment.note: v1 was 36 deg off its rig forward; v3 leg line and head centre are on the rig -Y axis.

deformation_check.method: source/v3/check_v3_deformation.py: bone rotated 30 deg about world X at its head; median ratio of actual to rigid displacement for >0.9-weighted distal vertices (1.0 = skin follows the bone fully)
